name: Restless Alchemical Wraith
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
description: Emerging from the dense, chemical-laden mists of the Runescribed Alchemy Vault, the Restless Alchemical Wraith is a haunting silhouette of arcane tragedy and spectral torment. Its form is a swirling, translucent mass of dark, smoky vapors streaked with phosphorescent streaks of emerald and crimson--remnants of unstable alchemical reagents fused with restless souls. Jagged shards of shattered glass and twisted brass apparatuses seem to orbit its shifting core, reflecting eerie glimmers of the faintly glowing dwarven runes etched into its vaporous form. The wraith's face is a ghastly mask of despair, with hollow, gemlike eyes that flicker with unnatural light, as if containing trapped alchemical fire within. Its movements are fluid yet unnatural, gliding silently over the granite benches cluttered with shattered vials and scorched crucibles, leaving faint trails of acrid smoke and a lingering chemical tang that stings the nostrils. It manifests with a mournful, whispering hiss, as if lamenting the catastrophic failures of the ancient dwarven alchemists whose secrets it now guards. The air around it crackles faintly with volatile energy, warning of sudden, devastating bursts of alchemical fury should it be provoked. This wraith is bound to the vault's arcane residues, eternally restless, a spectral guardian entwined in the tragic echoes of forbidden experimentation.
